title: Select an option
summary: A select input stores an option value. The label shown to people can differ from that value.
introduction: A select input stores an option value. The label shown to people can differ from that value. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A select input stores an option value. The label shown to people can differ from that value.

blocks.title: Select an option

blocks.text: The Large option is selected and its value is l.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Select s and check the value.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Use selectOption for a native select, not for every custom menu.
For more detail later, use this [Playwright further reading](https://playwright.dev/docs/intro).
